correctness.rationale: The graph is the Cayley graph of S_n generated by adjacent-position swaps, so graph distance is Kendall discordant-pair distance and K_n=Cl(P_n²) at inclusive scale two. Independently generated complete n=5 and n=6 graphs and all faces by direct discordance counting/clique extension and exact GF(2) elimination, not from stored output: n5 f=(120,780,1320,690,120), boundary ranks (119,661,570,120), reduced H3 zero; n6 f=(720,6840,15360,12060,4320,720), ranks (719,6121,8370,3600,720), reduced beta2=869 and beta3=90. Smaller n=1–4 have no degree-three homology by the package exhaustive rank computations (n4 top ∂3 rank 30, n3 has no 3-simplices). Checked the infinite proof separately: deletion π_T of outside labels is 1-Lipschitz, insertion i_T at front followed by increasing complement is an isometric embedding and π_T i_T=id. For T≠U, π_T i_U factors via K_|T∩U|, with intersection ≤5 and vanishing H3; the direct sum of projections is a left inverse to the direct sum of inclusions. Therefore the 90*C(n,6) rank bound is rigorous for all n≥6 rather than extrapolated from six-letter finite tests.
